reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our DM. I went through all six of Moss's notes I can see, and they mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

  #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because the gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard wasn't sending text-message bay assignments to drivers at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it the same day and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.

  #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). The gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to the second-level support team for scanner firmware testing. The note has no date.

I told her what I left out and why:
  - Moss's other two Quarrendon notes (2025-09-14 and 2026-03-23) don't give any ticket numbers.
  - #4409, #4412 and FR-882 are in Moss's Central team notes, but they belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.
  - Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer.

I only checked Moss's notes, which are all public files. I didn't read the Quarrendon incident channel or any other sources. Nothing in the reply needed approval.
